sources.title: Harvest Heroes Small but Mighty Rescue Routes
sources.fact: A historical Wednesday route collected from Fresh Thyme and Aldi and delivered to Open Door Ministry in Canton.
sources.boundary: A published operating example, not a verified current route or cancellation incident.

sources.title: New Food Donor Walmart in Bethel Park
sources.fact: Volunteers began collecting ongoing donations from Walmart in Bethel Park for local nonprofit partners.
sources.boundary: The article does not identify a recipient organization or document a cancellation.

sources.title: 412 Food Rescue Celebrates 9 Years with FoodRescueHero Week
sources.fact: One reported rescue delivered from Giant Eagle in South Side to Allegheny County Housing Authority Dorchester.
sources.boundary: A dated completed rescue, not a reported last-minute recovery.

sources.title: 412 Food Rescue Volunteer Handbook
sources.fact: The handbook requires staff approval for route changes and directs substitution requests within one hour of the pickup window to dispatch.
sources.boundary: Organization-specific instructions inform the human approval design; they are not a universal operating or food-safety standard.

sources.title: Streamlining for Good Food Rescue Hero Maximizes Impact Through 2023 Tech Improvements
sources.fact: The platform already added volunteer substitute push notifications and improved records of rescue changes and notification delivery.
sources.boundary: Existing replacement features must be acknowledged; a distinct unresolved recovery gap remains a research hypothesis.

sources.title: Operational Efficiency and Automation
sources.fact: The vendor describes last-minute substitutions, route optimization, multi-stop planning, and live rescue tracking.
sources.boundary: Vendor-described capabilities, not an independent performance benchmark or an endorsement.
